newsitem.title: USA: Talley names Foster interim Chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Talley names Foster interim Chairman, CEO.

text.p: Talley Industries on Monday said it has named retired Rear Admiral Paul Foster as an interim chairman and chief executive officer replacing William Mallender, who announced his resignation last week.

Foster, who left the United States Navy in 1979, will serve Talley in a transitional role during the search for Mallender's permanent replacement. Foster has been a Talley board member since 1992, and he was the unanimous choice for the job, Talley said in a statement.
He has taken a leave of absence from Saint Joseph's University in Philadelphia where he has been a professor of finance from 1979 to the present.

"The board and I are committed to establishing a strategy for the company which will build on Talley's core competencies to enhance growth prospects and increase shareholder value," Foster said in a statement.
Foster retired from the Navy with the rank of Rear Admiral, Supply Corps. During his naval career, he was twice awarded the Legion of Merit for outstanding service.
Mallender announced his resignation June 3, after dissident shareholders sought his dismissal in a recent shareholder vote.
